digest.component_or_area: snapshot compaction and orphan event handling
propositions: Natural fold enumeration retires and cites un-cited pre-snapshot orphan events in source_event_uuids despite not replaying their effects, causing repairable damage to become permanently undetectable after compaction threshold crossing.

The fold must exclude fsck-defined orphans (pre-snapshot events absent from a prior snapshot's source_event_uuids) from both retirement and citation, preserving the ORPHAN_EVENT signal and repair window indefinitely.

Pre-snapshot foldable candidates must be deferred from folding while their governing snapshot remains within the horizon, preventing silent burial of orphans under a newly-written pre-snapshot snapshot.
fsck --repair-snapshots must apply the same _AUTO_RECOVER vs _HUMAN_TRIAGE type routing as fsck --repair instead of rebuilding unconditionally on any orphan type.
A shared is_snapshot_orphan predicate must be extracted and reused between compact_txn.py and fsck_scan.py so the two code paths cannot drift in orphan definition.

Repair window and fsck ORPHAN_EVENT signal must survive indefinitely across fold operations for tickets with un-cited pre-snapshot events until explicit repair via fsck --repair or fsck --repair-snapshots.
